# Pull Request

## Description

Please include a summary of the changes.

## Why

Why is this change needed? Link to related issues or discussions.

## Testing

Have you run local checks? Confirm:

- [ ] `npm run check` passes

## Security Checklist

- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files are staged
- [ ] No new dependencies were added without justification
- [ ] No security hardening was weakened (rate limiter, CSP, input validation, etc.)

## Deployment Notes

If this PR affects deployment, site behavior, or configuration:

- [ ] Document changes to `vercel.json`, API endpoints, or environment variables

**Note**: This is the hosting/deployment repository for CircuitCoach. Simulator logic changes should go to the [canonical repository](https://github.com/nevodesigns/circuitcoach).
